data.title: Cross-Platform Deposit and Withdrawal Chain
data.description: Detects a pattern where funds are received via one payment rail (e.g., ACH, wire) and then immediately sent out via a different payment rail (e.g., Zelle, FedNow) within a short window. This cross-rail chaining is a common layering technique used to obscure the origin of funds and complicate tracing, often associated with money mule operations and authorized push payment fraud monetization.

detection.condition: (selection_inbound and selection_outbound and filter_amount) | temporal(ordered=true, maxspan=4h, by=account_id)

falsepositives: Freelancer receiving ACH payroll and immediately paying rent via Zelle
Business account receiving wire payment and disbursing to vendors via instant payment
